tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil chog bdud rtsi'i zegs ma bzhugs so// oṃ swā sti/ 'dir gdugs dkar dkyil chog sde dge zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyi zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa las ngag 'don gang yin zur du bkod de ras bris sgrub mchod bya tshul ni/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar la 'di skad do/ oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku/ /gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che/ /gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che/ /dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags/ /pad+ma mngon mtshan rdo rje'i mtshan/ /gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can/ /rdo rje 'khar bsnams 'joms pa mo/ /zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod ma/ /gzugs zhi gzi brjid chen mo can/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan dang / /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin ma/ /lag na rdo rje rigs ser phreng / /leb brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma/ /snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags/ /rnam par bsgyings ma rdo rje dang / /gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma/ /rdo rje'i 'gros dang dkar mo dang / /pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang / /phyag rgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod/ de nas rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis/ gtor ma oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā/

zhes pa lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ spos dang bcas te thal mo sbyar la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun gyi byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams dang / nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa kun la sbyar te/ 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa rnams la༞ rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la༞ lan gcig phyir 'ong ba rnams la༞ phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la༞ 'jig rten na yang dag par song ba rnams la༞ yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la༞ lha'i drang srong dmod pa 'dor ba phan 'dogs nus pa rnams la༞ rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams la༞ tshangs pa la༞ dbang po la༞ legs ldan drag po dka' thub bzlog pa'i bdag po dang lhan cig pa rnams la༞ legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa la༞ legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa dur khrod na gnas par mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa la༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la phyag༞ pad+ma'i gdung la༞ rdo rje'i gdung la༞ nor bu'i gdung la༞ glang po'i gdung la༞ gzhon nu'i gdung la༞ klu'i gdung la༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa la༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sā la'i dbang po'i me tog kun tu rgyas pa la༞

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi rgyal po la༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po la༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan rgyas pa ut+pa la'i dri bsung gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba phyir bzlog pa chen mo 'dis 'byung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcod pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba las bzlog pa/ sems can gsod pa dang bcings pa thams cad las grol ba/ sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas ngan pa thams cad bzlog pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ gdon stong phrag brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jig par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa/ gza' chen po brgyad 'jig par byed pa/ dgra thams cad bzlog pa/ ma rungs pa dang sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ dug dang mtshon dang me dang chu las sgrol ba ste/ rig sngags kyi cho ga 'di sbyar bar bya'o/ /glo bo'i rgyal po sras sku mched yum btsun mo/ blon 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pas rig sngags 'di grub par gyur cig swā hā/ 'byung po'i tshogs gang su dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang / nam mkhar rgyu ba rnams dang / chu la rgyu ba rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / rlung lha rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang /

dri za rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / srin po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / 'byung po rnams dang / grul bum rnams dang / srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / skem byed rnams dang / smyo byed rnams dang / brjed byed rnams dang / grib gnon rnams dang / gnon po rnams bdag la nyon cig 'byung po'i tshogs gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang / mdangs 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su mngal za ba rnams dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su sha za ba rnams dang / /zas su tshil za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang / srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang / zas su phreng ba za ba rnams dang / zas su dri za ba rnams dang / zas su bdug pa za ba rnams dang / zas su me tog za ba rnams dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang / zas su sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang / zas su rnag za ba rnams dang / zas su phyi sa za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang / zas su mchil ma za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snab za ba rnams dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / zas su skyug pa za ba rnams dang / zas su stor khung nas babs pa 'thung ba rnams dang / sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bdag la nyon cig rig sngags chen mo 'di bsgrub par bya'o/ /spos dang me tog dang bdug pa dang gtor ma yang sbyin no/ /gtor ma dang mchod pa 'di bzhes nas mgu bar gyis la/ glo bo sogs gong bzhin la 'khor dang bcas pa la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang /

sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / gzi brjid 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad phyir dengs shig ces brjod la rol mo drag po bya'o/ /gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags dang / oṃ a pi ta na nas/ pra taṃ gi ra phaṭa bar dang / gtso mo'i sngags dang a mṛ ta brjod cing gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro/ /de nas mtshams bcad par bya ste thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen mo'i bkas glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas la sdig pa dang / sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / lha'i gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang / mi'am ci'i gdon rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang / srul po'i gdon rnams dang / lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang / skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang / grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang / brjed byed kyi gdon rnams dang / gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang / bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon rnams dang / re lde 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang / tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang /

rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang / nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / /nyin gsum pa rnams dang / /nyin bzhi pa rnams dang / nyin bdun pa rnams dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang / rims mi zad pa rnams dang / rims sdang dub pa dang / 'byung po'i rims rnams dang / rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / bad kan las gyur pa dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / rims nad thams cad dang / klad pa na ba dang / gzhog phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / rtsibs log na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto ba na ba dang / rked pa na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / brla na ba dang / rje ngar na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba dang / rims dang / shu ba dang / g.ya' ba dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mtshan bar rdol ba dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang / bas ldag dang / me dbal dang / g.yan pa dang / lhog pa dang / skems pa dang / skrag pa dang / lud pa lu ba dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / mi dran pa dang / dbyig dug dang / dug sbyar ma dang / byad dang / me dang / chu dang / mi ngas dang / dgra dang / gnod pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa thams cad kyi rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o/ /gzi brjid 'phrog par bgyi'o/ /gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcad par bgyi'o/ /gdon thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o/ /gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo 'dis dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad du gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ ban+dha ban+dha badz+ra ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod do/

/de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhes pa nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shap+ta swā hā'i bar so so'i phyag rgya dang dharmā ra ṇi sogs dang / rol mor bcas kyis byin dbab bo/ /bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan nyer gcig sogs/ thal sbyar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang nyid skad cig gis gdugs dkar po can du gsal ba'i snying ga'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ dri ma med pa'i shel ltar dkar zhing gsal ba'i oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus thams cad gang / thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyi rol du 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ 'od kyi snang ba des rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/

zhes pas spyan drangs/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ /zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan/ /phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan gyis mi thub dbus dang gzhan/ /phyogs mtshams grwa sgo bzhi bzhi ru/ /bzhugs nas tha dad las mdzad ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la bstod/ /gdung bdun de bzhin gshegs pa bcu/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dang / /legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas/ /drang srong rig 'dzin grub rnams la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas phyag bya/ so so'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs kyis rgyun bshags lan gsum byas la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pa'i tshogs rten rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge oṃ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus oṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po lte ba la oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ khyad par 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon dang mdangs 'phrog par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim pas yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo/

sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ rtsa zhal nyis brgya snying rje dang zhi ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas zhal nyis brgya sgeg pa dpa' ba'i zhal ser po/ rgyab zhal nyis brgya rgod pa dang drag shul gyi zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal nyis brgya rngams pa dang nyams sna tshogs pa'i zhal ljang gu/ steng zhal nyis brgya mi sdug pa dang 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal sngon po zhal re re la nyams sna tshogs pa'i spyan gsum gsum gyis mtshan pa/ zhal la la bzhad pa/ la la mche ba gtsigs pa/ la la rab tu gdangs pa/ la la ljags 'dril zhing ha ha zhes drag tu bzhad pa/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin/ g.yas 'og ma rnams na 'khor lo dgu bcu go dgu/ rdo rje brgya/ rin po che brgya/ pad+ma brgya/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba brgya bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gyi dang pos mda' dang bcas pa'i gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og ma rnams na mda' dgu bcu go dgu/ gzhu brgya/ lcags kyu brgya/ zhags pa brgya/ ral gri 'bar ba brgya bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas lnga brgya bskum zhing / g.yon lnga brgya brkyangs pas 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang / mdangs 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad dang / ma rung pa'i gdon thams cad mnan pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ sku'i cha thams cad las 'dzum pa dang / zur gyis lta ba dang / rnam par bgrad pa dang / glog ltar 'gyu ba la sogs pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong mang pos ma rung pa thams cad 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ spyi gtsug na mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags su khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa me 'od rab tu 'bar bas mtshan pa/ 'phags pa thams cad la mchod pa dang / sdug bsngal can rnams la skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang /

ma rung pa rnams zil gyis gnon pa ste 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba'i dbus na gdugs pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lha ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ de la mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rol mo rdor 'dzin dril gsil gdangs yod med gang byung gis/ hūm̐ bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing / /bde 'byung bstan la gnod pa phyir bzlog cing / /bde gshegs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde mchog gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/

/skyabs sbyin la sogs phyag rgya sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri mda' gzhu zhags pa sogs bsnams pa'i/ /phyag stong mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar sngo dmar ser ljang gu'i kha dog can/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang / /zhi dang khro dang 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan pa'i/ /dbu stong mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu dang phyag sogs sku yi cha rnams la/ /zur gyis blta dang rnam par bgrad pa dang / /glog ltar 'khyug byed bye ba brgya stong gi /spyan rnams mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje lta bu mi phyed brtan pa'i sku/ /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i me dpung gis/ /bgegs rnams 'joms shing dngos grub myur stsol ba'i/ /mi phyed 'bar ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'bar ba'i mthus/ /thogs pa med cing shin tu yangs pa yi/ /sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun la mnga' mdzad ma/ /srid gsum dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rung 'byung po mtha' dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mi bzad 'jigs tshul gtso mo drag shul can/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /gdug pa tshar gcod ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs kar pad nyi gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis char sprin ltar gnag cing / /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /'byung gdon tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod la/ lha sku me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam/ dbang po'i gzhu lta bur gyur pa la yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /shes pa 'phro na sngags kyi bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ lha mo'i thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng oṃ gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du bkod pa las las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad par gyur/ zhes dang / tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/

kha sa me kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhi na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ta ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas pa ni bsnyen pa'i sngags so/ /las kyi sngags ni gzungs ring ste/ de bzlo bar 'dod pas rang gi sku'i cha las 'phros pa'i khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs mtshon cha du ma thogs pa dpag tu med pas pha rol gyi rig sngags kyi zhags pa thams cad bcad/ rig sngags sbyor ba po dang / zlo ba po dmag dpung phas rgol thams cad la phur bus btab pa sogs mnar ba'i las mdzad par gyur ces dang / oṃ si tā na lārka pra bhā s+phu ṭa bi ka si tā ta pa tre/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khā da khā da/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha tā ya phaṭa/ wa ta dā ya phaṭa/ wa ra pra da ya phaṭa/ pra t+yaṃ gi rā ya phaṭa/ ces pa bzla'o/ /bzlas pa tshar ba dang bdag bskyed kyi shākya dpal gyis ma bshad kyang 'gro mgon 'phags pas bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa dbyung bar bshad pa rgyud gzhung gi bzhed par 'thad che ba ltar byas/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ zhes dang sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bstsal du gsol zhes 'dod don zhus la yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol te/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol la rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /sa lha sta gon ni/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i cha lugs can rin po che'i rgyan gyis bklubs pa/

phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar bzung ba/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du hūm̐ bsam la hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī/ re re'i sngon du 'gro bas ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas shap+ta'i bar rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ a hūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu thogs nas mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i sgo nas glo bo sogs gong bzhin la 'khor dang bcas pa bar chad las bskyab par 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang bstsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod pas/

des kyang rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam la/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par bsam mo/ /lha sta gon ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi 'khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ steng rdo rje'i gdugs dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad bskal pa 'jig pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su sum yongs su gyur pa las lhun po rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lhe bar bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba la steng nas chu srin gyi kha nas dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dkar po/ mda' yab pad+ma'i 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis mdzes pa ste/ de dag gi bar bar du bum pa la gnas pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la gnas pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ nang rdo rje'i gdugs dang ka ba brgyad kyis mig mang ris su mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje'i nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi steng 'og gi phyogs thams cad shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus dkar ba/ phyi rol du 'jig rten khor yug dkar pos bskor ba'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ges btegs pa'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/

'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma dang / phyi'i gra bzhir pad+ma dang zla ba/ sgo bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa si twa ta pa tre na ma/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar dang / dzi ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa lī nā ma/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad kyi gdan la shar du gtum pa chen mo sku mdog dkar mo g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gzhan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ satwaṃ ma hā dz+wa lā nā ma/ lhor 'bar ba chen mo ser mo g.yas rin po che g.yon sdigs mdzub/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ moṃ ma hā gau rī nā ma/ nub tu dkar mo chen mo dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can g.yas pad+ma g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gsod pa dang 'ching pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ laṃ tā rā nā ma/ byang du sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad ma/ rmi ltas ngan pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ baṃ dzi na badz+ri nī nā ma/ byang shar du gzhan gyis mi thub ma sngon mo g.yas dbyug pa g.yon sdigs mdzub/ dug thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ paṃ pad+ma a bhi lak+ṣa ṇā nā ma/ shar lhor pad+ma'i mngon mtshan can ser mo g.yas lcags kyu g.yon sdigs mdzub/ mtshon gyi gnod pa thams can 'joms par mdzad ma/ paṃ a pa rā dzi tā nā ma/ lho nub tu gzhan gyis mi thub ma dmar mo g.yas rdo rje'i phreng ba g.yon sdigs mdzub/ me dang chu'i gnod pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ paṃ badz+roṣ+ṇī nī nā ma/ nub byang du rdo rje mchu can ma ljang gu g.yas ral gri g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma yid tsam khros shing /

pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /dhaṃ shān+ta de wī na ma/ de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi'i byang shar du zhi ba'i lha mo dkar mo g.yas bdug spos kyi snod g.yon sdigs mdzub/ sdang ba'i dgra thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ paṃ shān+ta ka na ka mā lī nī nā ma/ shar lhor zhi ba gser phreng can ser mo g.yas gser phreng g.yon sdigs mdzub/ ma rung pa'i dgra'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ āṃ ma hā go rī dz+wa lā nā ma/ lho nub tu dkar chen 'bar ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can g.yas mar me'i sdong bu g.yon sdigs mdzub/ sdang ba gshin rje thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ gaṃ ar+yā tā rā nā ma/ nub byang du 'phags ma sgrol ma ma rgad kyi mdog can g.yas dri'i dung phor g.yon sdigs mdzub/ 'chi ltas rmi ngan thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ thams cad kyang pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhi ba'i ngang tshul can no/ /paṃ badz+ra pa ram+pa ra ṇī nā ma/ shar sgor rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma sngon mo g.yas lcags kyu g.yon sdigs mdzub/ pha rol gyi rig sngags ngan pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ tsaṃ badz+ra kau mā rī nā ma/ lho sgor rdo rje gzhon nu ma gser ltar ser ba g.yas zhags pa g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gdon thams cad 'joms mdzad ma/ aṃ badz+ra pā ṇā nā ma/ nub sgor lag na rdo rje ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog g.yon sdigs mdzub/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar mdzad ma/ aṃ rat+na badz+ri ni nā ma/ byang sgor rin chen rdo rje ma ljang gu g.yas dril bu g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gza' chen po brgyad 'joms par mdzad ma/ bzhi ka'ang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing cung zad khro ba'i ngang tshul can/ lha mo thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos sna tshogs kyis stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba'o/

/phyi'i khor yug la legs ldan mched gsum/ 'jig rten skyong ba bcu dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu rnams rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs dang lag cha rnams 'chang zhing rang rigs kyi 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas par gyur par bsam la/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐ sngon po/ dbus su rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma lha bcu bdun rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes pa nas/ mchog rnams legs par bstsal du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /zhes sogs dang / kun rig bzhin sh+lau ka gnyis sngags dang bcas/ ji ltar bltams pa la sogs/ sngags dang bcas pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i sogs dang / mtshan sngags gong ma'i mthar/ at+ma tsan+d+ra pa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu swāhā/ zhes pas gdan phul nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza pañca ku la sngon 'gros mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/

sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res dbur brgyan/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ yo byad rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa rnam pa mchod rdzas ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par byed pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / khyad par bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod/ mi nus na thog ma'i mchod pa byin rlabs ltar brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod pa so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas gdangs dang bcas te/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyangs phyir du/ /sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i bag chags dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri ba wa ra thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa'i mchod yon dang / dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed cing / /kha dog dbyibs legs mdzes pa'i me tog 'di/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul te/ /gzhal med khang du sprin bzhin gtib gyur cig /puṣ+pes me tog dang / tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ /sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pa/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig

/dhuṣ+pes bdug spos dang / nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i/ /shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du/ /'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur khyab gyur cig ā lo kes mar me dang / stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i/ /spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang sbyar ba'i chu/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bdud rtsi'i char babs pas/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig ghan+dhes dri chab dang / rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don phyir lha yi bdud rtsi'i bshos/ /dag cing gtsang mar sbyar 'di 'bul lags na/ /ye shes thugs rje can gyis bzhes su gsol/ nai wid+yas zhal zas dang / /dril chen gsung dbyangs rnam rol tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /bsam gtan ngag gis bstod cing gsol 'debs na/ /sa bcu rim gyis bgrod la thogs med cing / /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por smon/ /shap+tas rol mo'i sgra/ dharma ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod/ gzhan yang / oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs kyis dpag tu med par spel nas/ rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa rnams kun rig sogs spyi ltar byas la/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ rdor 'dzin dril bsil gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing / /bde 'byung bstan la gnod pa phyir bzlog cing / /bde gshegs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde mchog gdugs dkar che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs sbyin la sogs phyag rgya sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri mda' gzhu zhags pa sogs bsnams pa'i/ /phyag stong mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar sngo dmar ser ljang gu'i kha dog can/ /sgeg dang dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang / /zhi dang khro dang 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan pa'i/ /dbu stong mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu dang phyag sogs sku yi cha rnams la/

/zur gyis blta dang rnam par bgrad pa dang / /glog ltar 'khyug byed bye ba brgya stong gi /spyan rnams mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje lta bu mi phyed brtan pa'i sku/ /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i me dpung gis/ /bgegs rnams 'joms shing dngos grub myur stsol ba'i/ /mi phyed 'bar ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'bar ba'i mthus/ /thogs ma med cing shin tu yangs pa yis/ /sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun la mnga' mdzad ma/ /srid gsum dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rung 'byung po mtha' dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mi zad 'jigs tshul gtso mo drag shul can/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /gdug pa tshar gcod ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs kar pad nyir gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis char sprin ltar gnag cing / /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /'byung gdon tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar gtum chen mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar/ /phyag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gzhan gyi sbyor ngan 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho yi pad+ma'i 'dab mar 'bar chen mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser gyi mdog ltar ser/ /phyag g.yas rin chen g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /dus min 'chi ba 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub kyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar gos dkar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar dmar can/ /phyag g.yas pad+ma g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gsod dang bcings pa grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang gi pad+ma'i 'dab mar sgrol ma che/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad lta bur ljang / /g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /rmi ltas ngan pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar 'dab mar rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis nam mkha'i mdog ltar sngo/ /phyag g.yas dbyug pa g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/

/dug rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho'i 'dab mar pad+ma'i mngon mtshan can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser zangs mdog mtshungs ma/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /mtshon gyi gnod pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub 'dab mar gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis li khri'i mdog ltar dmar/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje phreng ba g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /me chu'i gnod pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang pad+mar rdo rje mchu can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad mdog ltar ljang / /g.yas pa ral gri g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar grwa ru zhi ba'i lha mo ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ston ka'i zla ltar dkar/ /phyag g.yas bdug spos g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /dgra rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho'i grwa ru zhi ba gser phreng can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis btso ma gser gyi mdog /g.yas pa gser phreng g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /ma rung dgra rnams 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub grwa ru skar chen 'bar ba mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar dmar can/ /phyag g.yas mar me g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /sdang ba gshin rje 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang grwa ru 'phags ma sgrol ma ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog margad mdog /phyag g.yas dri yi dung chos g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /'chi ltas rmi ngan 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar gyi sgo ru rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbang sngon mdog ltar sngo/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /pha rol rig sngags 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho yi sgo ru rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser zangs mdog mtshungs ma/ /g.yas pas zhags pa g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub kyi sgo ru lag na rdo rje ma/

/zhal gcig phyag gnyis byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar/ /phyag g.yas lcags sgrog g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /rgyu skar dga' ba byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang gi sgo ru rdo rje rin chen ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad mdog dang mtshungs/ /g.yas pas dril bu g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /gza' rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi rol khor yug dkar po la gnas pa'i/ /dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal po chen po bzhi/ /gza' skar lha klu 'jigs byed dgu la sogs/ /mthu stobs che dang gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ /bstan pa srung mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod de/ de las lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas spos bzung / g.yon dril bu bcad gtub su dkrol zhing / /'phags ma gdugs dkar lha mo mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon pos 'bri bar 'tshal lags na/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyod rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan 'das mar bdag ni gus/ /des na bka' drin mdzad par rigs/ /'gro ba 'khor lo bya don gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gang yang gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba ma lus pa/ /'byung po byang chub nye bar gnas/ /gang dag rdo rje spyan mnga' ba'i/ /bstan la mngon par dga' ba kun/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge ste/ /'phags ma gdugs dkar dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i don phyir 'bri lags na/ /thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /dkyil 'khor lhan cig gyur pa kun/ /nye ba ru ni mdzad par rigs/ /lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ bshams pa'i gtor ma thams cad chu gtsang gis bran te/

/a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang / a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma dang po dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ /oṃ mdzod rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs/ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga sogs lan gsum gyis phul la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod pa bcom ldan rol mo bcas gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ lha mo nas lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo bar tshogs zhing skabs ltar/ bcom dril bu rgyun chags/ ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma 'khor dang bcas pas glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba dang / mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ gnyis pa sgos kyi chos skyong la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ nas mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol bar/ gur zhal gtor bsngo sbags sgrub bzhin/ lcam dral zhal gyi sngags sngon 'gro'i bstod pa'ang sbags sgrub bzhin/ bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod bar gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa rnams legs ldan mched gsum la dbul te/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ /mdun du paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gsum las legs ldan nag po dka' thub zlog pa g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ /legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa g.yas rtse gsum g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs par byed pa phyag gnyis tsan+dan gyi bing 'dzin cing sprul pa'i dmag tshogs 'gyed pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / rlon pas do shal byas pa/ rang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ oṃ shrī ma hā ka la sa pa ri wa ra e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa bstims la/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye se gol gtog oṃ ma hā kā la mā tri ga ṇa na maḥkri tā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta/ btags pa lan gsum gyis gtso bo gsum dang / /prah+ma ṇi ye/ biṣ+ṇa bī ye/ ma he shwa rī ye/ rau tri ye/ ma hā kā lī ye/ tsa muṇ+ḍī ye/ kau ma ri ye/ bā rā hī ye/ in+d+ra ye/ag+nī ye/ ya mā ye/ nai ṛ t+yā yai/ ba ru ṇa yai/ ma ru tī yai/ sau mā ye/ ī shā ni ye/ kā la daṇ+ḍī ye/ kā la rā trī ye/ ya ma daṇ+ḍi ye/ rā tri ye/ kā pā lī ye/ a dhi muk+ti sh+ma shā na ba si nī ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis 'khor rnams la 'bul/ rdor 'dzin dril gsil/ hūm̐/ bstan pa bsrungs dang bgegs tshogs 'joms/ /legs nyes btang 'dzin dam tshig can/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa'i/ /legs ldan 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i bkas/ legs ldan nag po mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pas glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pa la yongs su bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang /

chad par bzlog par mdzod cig ces pas gsol gdab 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro/ /drug pa bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa rnams rgyal chen bzhi la dbul te/ oṃ tsa tur ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭa ya/ bi rū dha kā ya/ bi rū pak+ṣa ya/ bai shrā ma ṇā ya/ ku bai rā ya/ sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta btags la dbul/ rdor 'dzin dril gsil/ ri rab chen po'i phyogs bzhi na/ /rgyal po chen po sde bzhi yang / /btsun mo sras 'khor bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ zhes bcom ldan 'das sogs nas bkas bar rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang sogs tshig bsgyur ba ma gtogs legs ldan bzhin/ dang phrin las zhu/ bcu pa dang / bcu gcig pa cha gsum bzhin 'on kyang a mṛ tas bsangs swa bhā was sbyangs a kā ro sogs kyis byin brlab/ phyogs skyong 'byung po la gtong ngo / /bcu gnyis pa dang bcu gsum pa ste gdon nyer brgyad la dbul te/ mi rdor 'dzin dril gsil/ sdug 'tshe ba'i ngang tshul can/ /gdon chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad po/ /rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ai h+ye his spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rdor thal kha phye se gol sarba de we bh+yaḥ sarba nā ge bh+yaḥ sarba rak+ṣa se bh+yaḥ sarba bhu ti bh+yaḥ sarba pre ta bh+yaḥ sarba pi shā tse bh+yaḥ sarba kum+bhaṇ+ḍe bh+yaḥ sarba pū ta ne bh+yaḥ sarba kan+ḍe bh+yaḥ sarba un+mā de bh+yaḥ sarba ts+tshā ye bh+yaḥ sarba a pasmā re bh+yaḥ sarba osta rā ge bh+yaḥ sarba ḍāk+ki nī bh+yaḥ sarba re ba tī bh+yaḥ sarba ya ma yai bh+yaḥ sarba sha ku ne bh+yaḥ sarba mā tri ga ṇe bh+yaḥ sarba kam+bu ka ni bh+yaḥ sarba ka ṭa pu ta ne bh+yaḥ sarba a wa lam+pa ke bh+yaḥ sarba kaṇ+ḍi ni bh+yaḥ sarba ghan+dhar+bhe bh+yaḥ sarba a su re bh+yaḥ

sarba kin+ne re bh+yaḥ sarba ga ru ḍe bh+yaḥ sarba ma ho ra ge bh+yaḥ sarba yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā btags pas phul la phrin las bcom ldan 'das bkas bar gdon chen nyer brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa sogs legs ldan bzhin zhu/ bcu bzhi nas bzhi bcu zhe gcig gi bar gzi brjid 'phrog pa'i gdon rnams la 'bul/ rdor 'dzin dril gsil/ gzi brjid 'phrog dang mdangs 'phrog dang / /mngal za sha za la sogs pa/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad gdon gyi tshogs/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hes spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rdor thal khag phye se gol/ te dzau dzā ha ra/ ba liṃ/ gar+bha/ ru dhi ra/ ba sā/ māṃ sa/ me da/ mar dzā/ dzā ta/ dzī wi ta/ bi rīṣ+ka/ mā li ta/ ghan+dha/ dhū pa/ puṣ+pa/ pha la/ ba s+ye/ a hu ti/ pū ya/ gu tha/ bi ṭa/ khe ṭa/ bān+ti/ sla sme/ siṃ ghā ni ga a puts+tsha/ dun+ta ni ka a hā re bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā sogs btags pas bsngos/ rdo rje thugs ka dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ gdon chen nyer brgyad 'khor bcas ni/ /gzi brjid 'phrog cing mdangs za bar/ /gzugs brnyan khrag snas brgyan pa 'bul/ /mngal za ba la mngar gsum rtsi/ /khrag 'thung ba la khrag sna 'bul/ zhag za ba la zhag dang bcud/ /sha za ba la sha yi tshogs/ /tshil za ba la phyi nang tshil/ /rkang za ba la rkang mar 'bul/ /btsas pa za la bu ram dang / /shing kun sbyar ba 'di dag 'bul/ /srog 'phrog pa la 'o ma dang / /zho dang ka ra bcas pa 'bul/ /skyug pa za la sbrang rtsi dang / /mi gtsang za la sgog btsong dang / /la phug rgyu rkyen sbyar la 'bul/ /gcin 'thung ba la rgun 'brum chang / /'bras chang bcud dang bcas pa 'bul/ /stor khung nas 'bab 'thung ba la/ /chu sna mang po bcud sbyar 'bul/ /lhag ma za ba zas kun gyi/ /lhag ma bsdus la 'bul bar bya/ /mchil ma 'thung ba sbrang dang bcud/ /bya mo'i sgo nga snabs za la/ /ngar sgong ngar snabs za la 'bul/

/rnag za ba la rus pa'i sha /gtor ma za la khur ba dang / /rab tu sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'bul/ /phreng ba za la ru rāk+ṣa/ /bo dhi tsit+ta la sogs 'bul/ /dri za ba la ga bur dang / /bzang sman drug dang bcas pa 'bul/ /bdug pa za la sbyar dug spos/ /dri dang 'bru mar bcas pa 'bul/ /sems 'phrog pa la sha khrag chang / /sgog btsong bcas pa'i gtor ma 'bul/ me tog za la me tog rigs/ /'bras bu za la bu ram dang / /shing thog sna tshogs bcas pa 'bul/ /lo tog za la 'bru bzang dang / /'bras dang nas kyi snye ma 'bul/ /sbyin sreg za la 'bru bcud dang / /'bras kyi lag zan dbul bar bya/ rang rang mthun rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /gnod pa'i bsam sbyor zhi ba dang / /phan pa'i sems pa ldan par gyis/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung bar mdzod/ /ces dang / phrin las gong bzhin bcol la/ zhe gnyis pa gzhi bdag la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ /bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥnas dge ba'i sdongs grogs nyid du mdzod bar gtor bsngo chen mo bzhin/ zhe gsum pa na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyan kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / /nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis glo bo sogs 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad skad cig thang gcig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig

ḍāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥsogs nas nye bar zhi ba gcig tu gyur cig bar bgegs gtor bzhin/ bum pa sta gon ni/ legs par bshams pa'i bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swāhā/ lha'i chu dang bcud kyis bkang ba/ oṃ kalpa bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ chu'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seṅges btegs pa'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan 'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma dang / phyi'i mtshams bzhir pad+ma dang zla ba/ phyogs bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros sogs nas thugs kar gzhan gyis mi thub ma bcas pa bskyed pa nas brtsam ste/ lha mo thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gtso 'khor bcu bdun 'og mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar dang / las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ cung zad khro ba'i nyams can rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ sogs nas rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can lha bcu bdun bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

ma lus sems can sogs sh+lau ka gsum sngags dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod kyi mchod pa nas gtso 'khor thams cad la rnam par snang mdzad dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa'i khyad par tsam ma gtogs gzhan thams cad mdun bskyed ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya'o/ /mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang / bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can zhes sogs dang / gzhan gyis mi thub sogs dang 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs sh+lau ka res bstod/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la phog pas/ de rnams dang lha rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ tad+ya thā/ a na le sogs bsnyen sngags ci nus dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ dzam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ gtum pa chen mo'i 'o/ /oṃ stam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ 'bar ba chen mo'i 'o/ /oṃ mo ha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ gos dkar mo'i 'o/ /oṃ lam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ sgrol ma'i 'o/ /oṃ ba ha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma'i 'o/ /oṃ sa ra bi ṣa saṃ bhak+ṣa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ pad+ma'i mngon mtshan ma'i 'o/ /oṃ sarba duṇ+ḍān pra duṣ+ṭā naṃ stam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i 'o/ /oṃ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa gra hā ṇaṃ bi dh+wan+sa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ rdo rje mchu can ma'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ zhi ba chen mo'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ zhi ba gser phreng ma'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ dkar chen mo'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe+e āḥhūm̐ druṃ/

'phags ma sgrol ma'i 'o/ /oṃ sarba pa rā bid+ya ts+tshe da na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud ma'i 'o/ /oṃ tsa tu ra shī tī nāṃ gra ha sa ha pra ṇaṃ bi dh+wan+sa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma'i 'o/ /oṃ aṣ+ṭā bi sha tī naṃ nak+ṣa tra pra sa da na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ lag na rdo rje ma'i 'o/ /oṃ aṣ+ṭa nāṃ ma hā gra hā naṃ bi dh+wan+sa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ rdo rje rin chen ma'i sngags te de rnams ci nus re dang / las bum la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas mthar mchod bstod gong bzhin dang 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi bzlas gtor gyi mjug bzhin/ ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul/ las bum las bum pa'i chu kha rgyan gyis 'thor zhing 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod de/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam mo/ /rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te/ bum bskyed kyi skabs ltar mchod bstod 'dod don zhus la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya ci rigs/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ gang yang bdag blo sogs/ gtso bo nus pa sogs gdangs bcas/ khu tshur rgyab sbyar ba mtheb srin sbyar ba dang / oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs la'ang ma 'byor pa'i gdangs bcas mthar mtheb srin gyis sel gol dang oṃ badz+ra muḥ sta gon gyi lha rnams sang nangs par 'byon par bzhed bzhin pas rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs zhes brjod cing bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags ma gdugs dkar 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/

/de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang / 'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gis/ /thog med nas bsags nad mtshon mu ge yi/ /las sgrib ma lus byang zhing dag gyur cig /'gro kun dga' bde'i dpal la rtag dgod phyir/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /nad mtshon mu ge'i rgud bral bde skyid kyi/ /mthar thug gyur nas bsam don kun 'grub shog /de ltar srid pa'i dpal la longs spyod cing / /bdag cag rnams kyi spyod lam phra mo tshun/ /ma lus bstan dang 'gro ba'i don gyur nas/ /rgyal sras spyod pas don gnyis lhun 'grub shog /pha rol phyin dang bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud sde'i don la sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas/ /rtse gcig theg mchog rim gnyis rnal 'byor gyi/ /dpe yi ye shes tshe 'dir 'char bar shog /skyabs gnas bslu med rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /bdag gi dad pa'i shugs dang chos kyi dbyings/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /'og nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis sogs bya'o/ /sta gon no/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i ngag 'don rim pas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas bdag bskyed rdzogs pa'i bar sta gon bzhin/ de nas dkyil 'khor las bum gyi chu dang / a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa nas nyi ma'i gdan bar sta gon bzhin/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du yi ge oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus oṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po'i lte ba la oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems cad thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ khyad par 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon dang mdangs 'phrog par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/

tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo sogs nas dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gong ltar thugs kar gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang bcas pa bskyed/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad kyi gdan shar du dzaṃ las gtum pa chen mo sku mdog dkar mo g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gzhan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ lhor satwaṃ las 'bar ba chen po sogs/ nub tu oṃ las gos dkar mo sogs/ byang du laṃ las sgrol ma sogs/ byang shar du baṃ las rgyal ba'i sogs/ shar lhor paṃ las pad+ma'i sogs/ lho nub tu saṃ las gzhan gyis sogs/ nub byang du paṃ las rdo rje'i sogs nas bzhugs pa'i bar/ de'i phyi rol du byang shar gyi grwar dhaṃ las zhi ba'i sogs/ shar lhor paṃ las zhi ba sogs/ lho nub tu aṃ las dkar chen sogs/ nub byang du gaṃ las 'phags ma sogs nas ngang tshul can no bar/ shar sgor paṃ las rdo rje lu gu sogs/ lho sgor tsaṃ las rdo rje gzhon nu sogs/ nub sgor aṃ las lag na rdo rje sogs/ byang sgor aṃ las rin chen sogs nas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbar sta gon bzhin/ dngos gzhi dang po'i tshe sta gon gyi lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang / gnyis pa man chad rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan 'dren pa yin pas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sogs/ ma lus sems can nas dbur brgyan bar sta gon bzhin/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba la so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs te/ sngags phreng las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad sbyangs nas/

'od zer rnams slar 'dus te lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim/ lha so so la dmigs te gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags rnams ji ltar rigs par bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ mchod bstod rgyas pa sta gon bzhin/ rgya gar skad du/ nas mngon par bstod do bar gdugs dkar mchog grub kyi mdo tshar gcig de nas 'phrin las gzhol ba ni/ thal mo sbyar la oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si twa ta pa tre hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad mas glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba dang / mi nad dang phyugs nad dang / yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ dzam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ shar gyi gtum chen mos glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba dang / gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ staṃ bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ lho phyogs kyi 'bar ma chen mos glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba dang /

dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ de bzhin du glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba dang / zhes pas kun la sbyar te/ oṃ mo hā na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ nub phyogs kyi gos dkar mos༞ bsad pa dang bcings pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ laṃ bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ byang phyogs kyi sgrol mas/ rmi ltas ngan pa'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ ba ha ni ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ byang shar gyi rgyal ba'i rdo rje mas༞ brtan g.yo'i dug gi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ sa ra bi ṣa saṃ bhak+ṣa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ shar lho'i pad+ma'i mngon mtshan mas༞ mtshon gyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ pra duṣ+ṭan satwaṃ bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ lho nub kyi gzhan gyis mi thub mas༞ me dang chu'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa gra hā ṇām̐ bi dh+wan+sa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ nub byang gi rdo rje mchu can mas༞ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra dhup+pe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ byang shar gyi zhi ba chen mos༞ dgra'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ shar lho'i zhi ba gser phreng can mas༞ ma rungs dgra chen gyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ lho nub kyi dkar mo chen mos༞ gshin rje'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ nub byang gi 'phags ma sgrol mas༞ rmi ltas ngan pa'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ sarba pā ra bīd+ya ts+tshe da na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ shar sgo'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud mas/ gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/

oṃ tsa tu rā shi tī nāṃ gra ha sa ha pra ṇāṃ bi dh+wan+sa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ lho sgo'i rdo rje gzhon nu mas༞ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa bi shi tī nāṃ nak+ṣa tra ṇaṃ pra sā dha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ nub sgo'i lag na rdo rje mas༞ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā nāṃ ma hā gra hā ṇāṃ bi dh+wan+sa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ byang sgo'i rdo rje rin chen mas༞ gza' chen po brgyad kyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das gdung bdun/ de bzhin gshegs pa bcu/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis༞ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ phyi'i khor yug la gnas pa legs ldan mched gsum/ 'jig rten skyong ba bcu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi mi nad dang phyugs nad sogs gong ltar brjod pas phrin las gsol lo/ dngos gzhi gnyis pa man dgos pa'i tshe bum pa sta gon gyi skabs bzhin 'dir bsgrub bo/ /gtor ma rnams sta gon bzhin btang / byad grol bdag 'jug dang bcas pa ni/ tshon skud sna lngar mdud pa byas pa rang gi mgrin par brgyus la yan lag lnga bcings par bsams la/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer rno zhing thogs pa med pa lcags kyu'i rnam pa can grangs med par 'phros/ glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pa'i snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib byad byur la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs su gyur pa thams cad 'od zer sngo dmar dang /

dud khu sol khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pa can dang / gdon bgegs la sogs pa sdig sbal sogs srog chags mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can du tshur bkug te/ lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud 'di la sib kyis thim zhes dang / rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis glo bo sogs nas 'khor dang bcas pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gnod sdig sgrib/ rmi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ dus ma yin bar 'chi bar gyur pa thams cad dang / byad dang mnan gtad du bcug pa la sogs pa gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa brtsams pa'i nus mthu thams cad rang dbang med par bkug te/ lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud lnga po 'di la gnyis su med par thim par gyur cig a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes mdzub mo gnyis bkug dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug lan gsum/ lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud 'di rnams nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ bcom ldan 'das mas ye shes kyi ral gri me dang chu'i ngar dang ldan pas tshon skud rnams dum bur bcad pas bar du gcod pa thams cad dang bral/ zhes dang / lha sngags rnams tshar gcig brjod la btub pa dang /

lhan cig glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /kun tu rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /tshangs pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /dbang phyug chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /nam mkha' lding dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /nag po chen pos byas pas rig sngags bcad do/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /rgyal bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang / don kun 'grub pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /srin mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /bh+ring gi ri ti dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /dge sbyong mgo reg gis byas pa'i rigs sngags bcad do/ /dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /pho nya dang pho nya mo dang bran pho dang bran mos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /drang srong gi tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /mi 'phrod pa za ba'i bdag pos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /oṃ a si tā na larka pra bhā s+phu ṭa bi ka si tā ha sa tre/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khā da khā da/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bin+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/

he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha tā ya phaṭa/ wa ra dā ya phaṭa/ wa ra pra da ya phaṭa/ pra t+yaṃ gi rā ya phaṭa/ ces pas bcad/ zhi ba'i thab nye logs su bzhag pa la me sbar/ las bum gyi chu dang sngags gnyis kyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgya tshad yongs su ma chad pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba las me 'bar ba/ de'i dbus su/ tshig bsgyur tsam ma gtogs bdag bskyed bzhin mchod bstod bar byas la tshon skud dum bu dang bsreg rdzas rnams bsres nas oṃ a si sogs/ gong gi sngags kyis nyer gcig phul mthar/ glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad la byad byur la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs su gyur pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod mchod bstod byas la thab kyi lha oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pa ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan me long la shar bar bum chu sbran zhing snod du bzed la dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ so sor sngags bcas sku khrus gsol/ de dag sku la sogs sku phyi/ snod kyi chu bum par blugs/ de nas lha bcu bdun gyi sngags mthar glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang / nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / nyin gsum pa rnams dang / nyin bzhi pa rnams dang / nyin bdun pa rnams dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang / rims mi zad pa rnams dang / 'byung po'i rims rnams te rims kyi gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ nad rlung las gyur pa rnams dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang / bad kan las gyur pa rnams dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa la sogs pa'i nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ lha'i gdon rnams dang /

klu'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon la sogs te gdon thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zas su mdangs 'phrog pa dang / zas su mngal za ba la sogs pa'i bgegs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ rkun po'i 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ me'i 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ chu'i 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ dug gi 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ mtshon gyi 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dgra'i 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba la sogs pa'i gnod byed bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pa'i bar la gdong dang lag pa sogs bkru ba'am/ yang na bum chu gtor/ lag g.yas pas bum pa'i kha rgyan rdo rje dang bcas pa bzung la/ lha bcu bdun gyi sngags kyi mthar/ bkru tshig rnams kyi rjes su/ a pa na ya swāhās byab/ rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rje btsun rtsa ba nas bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis glo bo sogs nas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par phyi'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du song zhig ces dang / rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol/ gtso mo dang las sngags/ rdor dril dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ /dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba las ni rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar gyur/ /rlung ni sprin las rab tu rgyal/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/

/sa yang bden par gnas pa lags/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ /bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma mchis/ /dza ya dza ya/ lha bcu bdun gyi sngags mthar/ spyi bo mdun rgyab dpung pa gnyis pus mo gnyis te gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram 'jog tshul byas la bkru sngags rnams kyi mthar rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥzhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi sogs maṇ+ḍal gyi mthar dbang gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du zhes dang / me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar la/ rig sngags lha mo chen mo dang / sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /lha mos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal/ /lan gsum/ gtso mo'i thugs ka nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dpag tu med pa byon nas dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta brjod cing las bum gyi chu gtor/ bdug spos kyis bdugs par bsams la/ bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wa ra ma ṇa ya hūm̐ zhes gdong 'ching tshul dang / ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes me tog len tshul/ de dang bcas pas thal sbyar gyis/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /sogs nas sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god bar kun rig sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid par mos la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo dud tsam dang bcas pas sa mā ya hūm̐/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa nas/ spyan rgyas pa ut+pa la'i gsung tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo bar phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da ya mi zhes sems bskyed nas snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥsid+dha badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas brtan par byas/ gsang bar gdams pa ni spyi bo ru rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /lha mo dang ri khrod ma rnams kyi rigs su gyur gyi ngas gdugs dkar mo'i sems bskyed par bya ste/

ye shes gang gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gdugs dkar po can dang ri khrod ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re zhes gsang bar gdams nas/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs kyi mthar/ dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du sogs me tog bcas thal sbyar gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / gdugs dkar po can mas byin gyis rlobs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang nyid skad cig gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ phyag stong mnga' ba nas 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi zhal phyag rdzogs par gsal 'debs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bskyed/ mdun bskyed gtso mo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam nas chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi bar grangs med dpag tu med pa spyan drangs rang gi lus la thim/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las kyang de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byon te/ rang la sib kyis thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ lha rnams kyi sngags tshang bar bzla zhing dril gsil bya'o/ /ye shes dbab pa spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas brtan par byas pa mos la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ

zhes me tog 'bul tshul dang / oṃ pra ti gṛ ha na satwaṃ mi maṃ sa satwaṃ/ ma hā ba la/ mgor 'ching tshul dang / badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ gdong g.yogs 'grol tshul dang / he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar po can ma'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar mthong ba yin no/ /dbang gi dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs kyi mthar/ dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du sogs dang / me tog thal sbyar gyis/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bral ba'i dbus su rin po che'i khri pad+ma zla ba dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid oṃ dkar po las bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma sogs nas gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ de'i steng du bla bre g.yas su gdugs g.yon du rgyal mtshan mtha' bskor kun tu dung la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ gtso mo'i thugs ka'i aṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal sbyar gyis/ oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs nas/ phyag rgya'i tshogs ni thams cad kyis/ /bdag la mngon par dbang bskur gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsol ba btab/ de rnams kyi dbang bskur bar bsams la/

bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pa'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa sogs nas/ bi dh+wan+sa ni ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hriṣ+ṭoṃ/ zhes pa'i bar/ lha thams cad kyi sngags la/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ btags te zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ slar yang skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang / mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bden stobs brjod de bde legs su bsgrub par bsam la/ bum pa mthong bzhin pas bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can rdo rje'i gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad mas glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad la rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang / rkun po'i 'jigs pa dang / me'i 'jigs pa dang / chu'i 'jigs pa dang / dug gi 'jigs pa dang / mtshon gyi 'jigs pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa dang / mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang / dgra'i 'jigs pa dang / lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang / sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa dang / skar mda' ltung ba'i 'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pa'i las kyi 'jigs pa dang / lha'i 'jigs pa dang / klu'i 'jigs pa dang / glog gi 'jigs pa dang / nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan khro bo'i 'jigs pa ste/ 'jigs pa mi bzad pa thams cad las glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad bsrung du gsol/ oṃ hūm̐ ṣ+ṭoṃ ban+dha ban+dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ sarba sa twāṃ bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ lha'i gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang /

mi'am ci'i gdon rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang / srul po'i gdon rnams dang / lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang / skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / brjed byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang / grib gnon kyi gdon rnams dang / gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang / bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon rnams dang / tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon te gdon thams cad las glo bo sogs oṃ hūm̐ ṣ+ṭoṃ ban+dha ban+dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba sa twāṃ bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ gnod sbyin dang gdon gang su dag zas su mdangs za ba rnams dang / gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams pa dang / zas su mngal za ba rnams dang / khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zhag za ba rnams dang / sha za ba rnams dang / tshil za ba rnams dang / rkang za ba rnams dang / btsas pa za ba rnams dang / srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / lhag ma za ba rnams dang / gtor ma za ba rnams dang / phreng ba za ba rnams dang / dri za ba rnams dang / bdug pa za ba rnams dang / me tog za ba rnams dang / 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / lo tog za ba rnams dang / sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang / rnag za ba rnams dang / phyi sa za ba rnams dang / gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / mchil ma 'thung ba rnams dang / skyug pa za ba rnams dang / snabs za ba rnams dang / ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / gtor khung nas babs pa 'thung ba rnams la sogs te bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad las glo bo sogs/ oṃ hūm̐ ṣ+ṭā+oṃ ban+dha ban+dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ sarba satwāṃ bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/

gzhan yang rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang / nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / nyin gsum pa rnams dang / nyin bzhi pa rnams dang / nyin bdun pa rnams dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang / rims mi bzad pa rnams dang / 'byung po'i rims rnams dang / rlung las gyur pa rnams dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang / bad kan las gyur pa rnams dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa la sogs te rims nad thams cad dang / klad pa na ba rnams bsal du gsol/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / snying na ba dang / klad pa na ba dang / rtsibs log na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto ba na ba dang / rked pa na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / brla na ba dang / rje ngar na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba rab tu bsal tu gsol/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad las glo bo sogs/ oṃ hūm̐ ṣ+ṭoṃ ban+dha ban+dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba sa twāṃ bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ gzhan gyis byas pa'i rig sngags ngan pa thams cad dang / gdon thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /kun tu rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /tshangs pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dbang phyug chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /nam mkha' lding dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /nag po chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /rgyal bar byed pa dang /
