sbrang rtsir byed pa dang don kun 'grub pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /bhṛṅgi ri ti dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dge sbyong mgo reg gis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /pho nya dang pho nya mo dang bran pho dang bran mos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /drang srong gi tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mi 'phrod pa za ba'i bdag pos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mdor na gzhan gyi rig sngags dang rbod gtong dang byad kha dang phur kha la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par glo bo sogs/ oṃ hūm̐ ṣ+ṭā+oṃ ban+dha ban+dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba sa twāṃ bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ bum pa kha rgyan gyis bum chu 'thor ba'i tshul bya zhing / bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje yangs pa chen mos glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad kyis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa dang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang /

srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / gnod par sems pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol/ rig sngags chen mo 'di grub par mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad mas/ phyogs thams cad rdo rje rwa ba dang dra ba dang phyag rgya'i tshogs thams cad kyis glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad kyi srog 'phrog cing gnod par semasapa'i rig sngags bcing du gsol/ mtshams bcing du gsol/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ shān+te shān+te/ dān+te dān+te/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bi re bi re/ badz+ra dha rī nī/ ban+dha ban+dha ni/ badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ druṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ druṃ ban+dha phaṭa/ ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ sarba dur laṃ ghi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭe k+ṣi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba dz+wa re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bha ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba u pa sarge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kri te karma ṇ-i ka kho dhe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ki ra ṇa be ra ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsats+tshā pre sha tsa dusha ts+tsha dhi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba du bhuk+te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba tir+thi ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba shra ma ṇe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pā ta ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bid+yā dha re bh+yeḥphaṭa/ dza ya ka ra ma dhu ka ra sarba ar+tha sa dha ke bh+yo bid+ya tsar+ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsa tur bh+yo bha gī nī bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kau mā rī badz+ra ku lan+dha ri bid+yā tsar+ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma hā pra t+yaṃ gi ra bh+yaḥphaṭa/ badz+ra shriṃ kha la pra t+yaṃ gi ra rā dzā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra pā ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa a na le/ a wa lo ki te/ mur+dha na te dzo rā pi/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dha ka dha ka dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bin+da bin+da/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba dang /

dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad dang / yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba dang / bkra mi shis pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ rdo rje'i rigs bye ba khrag khrig brgyad cu rtsa bzhis kyang 'di rnams la bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba bar mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/ bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des spyi bo nas mar zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang / tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang / nad dang gdon dang bgegs dang / nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad sangs kyis dag bcom ldan 'das ma'i spang rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid can du byin gyis brlabs/ cod pan dbang ni/ thal sbyar bkan pa las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad brkyang pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tor+bha ba badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bar bsam la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs lngas mchod/ 'byor pa thob pa'i phyir mtha' rten bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā hā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis gyi rdzas brgyad glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ maṃ ga la aṣ+ṭa dra bya hūm̐/ lan gsum/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du deng 'dir glo bo sogs nas snod bcud thams cad kyang me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig

me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /de bzhin du sbyar la/ glang po che sa srung gi sman gi waṃ phyag tu༞ gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu༞ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rtogs gyur nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dur ba phyag tu༞ dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /lha tshangs pas bil wa phyag tu༞ bil wa rgyu rkyen 'bras bu bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu༞ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /bram ze skar rgyal gyis li khri phyag tu༞ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes yungs dkar phyag tu༞ yungs dkar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/

/mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /dril gsil me tog dang bcas pas/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod pa'i mthar/ glo bo sogs snod bcud bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnal par rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig dbang gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig bsrung snyam pas me tog thal sbyar dang / gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal gyi mthar dbang bskur zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du sogs/ me tog thal sbyar gyis/ deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum/ mjug chog gi mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod 'dod gsol bum bskyed bzhin/ rdor sems yig brgya gsum sogs bzlas la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ gang yang bdag blo sogs/ gtso bo nus pa sogs/ sh+lau ka gsum la gdangs bcas phyogs bcu na sogs nas badz+ra ye swā hā bar kun rig nas 'byung ba bzhin gtor mgron rnams ni mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag pa'i lugs yin pas rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs nas gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba 'di yis myur tu bdag /'phags ma gdugs dkar 'grub gyur nas sogs/ 'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi /zhes pa nas/ 'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig gi bar gong bzhin phun sum tshogs pa sogs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis sam yang na/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos sogs ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ sogs/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ /zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan/ /phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /gtsug tor las byung bkra shis shog /gzhan gyis mi thub dbus dang gzhan/
